description.en: Characters originating from video games and game franchises.
description.zh: 来自电子游戏及游戏系列的角色。

description.en: Characters originating from anime, manga, light novels, and animation.
description.zh: 来自动漫、漫画、轻小说和动画作品的角色。

description.en: Creator-owned characters with an original identity and design.
description.zh: 由创作者拥有并具备原创身份与设计的角色。

description.en: Friendly brand, product, community, and personal mascot companions.
description.zh: 品牌、产品、社区或个人使用的吉祥物伙伴。

description.en: Pets based primarily on real-world animals and household companions.
description.zh: 以现实动物和日常陪伴动物为主体的宠物。

description.en: Magical creatures, monsters, hybrids, and supernatural companions.
description.zh: 魔法生物、怪物、混合生物和超自然伙伴。

description.en: Mechanical, robotic, AI, and coding-oriented companions.
description.zh: 机械、机器人、AI 和编程主题伙伴。

description.en: Real-person likenesses, creator avatars, and profile companions with a clear permission trail.
description.zh: 有清晰授权链的真人形象、创作者头像和人物资料伙伴。

description.en: Internet-native meme characters, reactions, and viral icons.
description.zh: 互联网原生的梗角色、反应形象和流行图标。

description.en: Animated objects, tools, food, vehicles, and prop-like companions.
description.zh: 会活动的物件、工具、食物、载具和道具型伙伴。

description.en: A temporary moderation fallback when no specific category fits.
description.zh: 没有具体分类适用时的临时审核兜底。
